input.story: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount coupon at checkout so that I pay less for my order.
input.context: Aurora Storefront checkout. Coupons give a percentage off the order total, up to a maximum discount of $30. A coupon works only on orders of at least $50. Each coupon can be used once per account and has an expiry date. Only one coupon per order. Guests can use coupons too.

criteria.text: Given a shopper has items worth more than $50 in the cart When they enter a valid coupon code Then the discount is applied to the order total And the new total is shown before payment
Given a shopper has items worth less than $50 in the cart When they enter a valid coupon code Then the coupon is refused with the message "This coupon needs an order of at least $50."
Given a coupon gives 20% off When the order total is $200 Then the discount is $30, not $40
Given a coupon has already been used by this account When the shopper enters it Then it is refused with "You have already used this coupon."
Given a coupon has expired When the shopper enters it Then it is refused with "This coupon has expired."

test_cases.title: A valid coupon on a cart over the minimum
steps: Put $60.00 of items in the cart
Enter a valid coupon code
test_cases.expected: The order total drops by the discount and the new total is shown

test_cases.title: A valid coupon on a cart under the minimum
steps: Put $40.00 of items in the cart
Enter a valid coupon code
test_cases.expected: The page shows: This coupon needs an order of at least $50.

test_cases.title: The discount stops at the cap
steps: Put $200.00 of items in the cart
Enter a coupon for 20% off

test_cases.title: A coupon the account has already used
steps: Enter a coupon this account used last week
test_cases.expected: The page shows: You have already used this coupon.

test_cases.title: An expired coupon
steps: Enter a coupon whose expiry date has passed
test_cases.expected: The page shows: This coupon has expired.

add_tests.title: A discount worth more than the cart leaves a sensible total
steps: Put one cheap item in the cart
Apply the coupon
Read the total and open the payment step
add_tests.expected: The total is zero or the smallest amount the shop allows, never below zero, and payment asks for the same amount the cart shows.
add_tests.test_data: cart of $5.00 with a coupon worth $30

add_tests.title: 15% of $59.99 is the same number in the cart, at payment and on the receipt
steps: Apply the coupon and write down the discount and the total
Go to the payment step and write down the amount asked for
Finish the order and open the receipt
add_tests.expected: The discount is the same amount in all three places, to the cent, and the three totals agree.

add_tests.title: Two tabs applying one single-use coupon end with one discounted order
steps: Fill a cart in each tab and apply the same coupon in both
Press pay in the first tab, then within a second press pay in the second
Open the order list and the coupon's usage record
add_tests.expected: Exactly one order carries the discount; the other is refused with a message about the coupon being used, and the coupon is recorded as used once.
add_tests.test_data: coupon ONCE50, two tabs, same account

add_tests.title: A guest who already used the coupon is refused the second time
steps: Start a new guest checkout with shopper@example.com
Enter the same coupon
Read the message and the total
add_tests.expected: The coupon is refused with the same message a signed-in shopper would see, and the total has no discount.
add_tests.test_data: email shopper@example.com used twice as a guest

add_tests.title: A code that doesn't exist is refused and the total does not change
steps: Write down the total before anything is entered
Enter FAKE123 and apply it
Read the message and the total
Enter SAVE2O, with the letter O instead of a zero, and apply it
Read the message and the total again
add_tests.expected: Both codes are refused with a message that says the code is not recognised; the total is the same as it was before each attempt, and no discount line appears.
add_tests.test_data: FAKE123 (no such code), SAVE2O (SAVE20 with a letter O)

add_tests.title: A pasted code with spaces and small letters still works
steps: Open the cart and paste ' save20 ' into the coupon box, spaces and all
Apply it
Look at the total and the message
add_tests.expected: The coupon is accepted, the discount is taken off the total, and no message about a wrong code is shown.
add_tests.test_data: code typed as ' save20 ' (two spaces, small letters)

add_tests.title: Boundary values at $49.99 / $50.01 (AC-1)
steps: Enter a valid coupon code.
Enter a valid coupon code.
Check the result.
add_tests.expected: At $49.99: the coupon is refused with the message "This coupon needs an order of at least $50." (AC-2). At $50.01: the discount is applied to the order total; the new total is shown before payment.

add_tests.title: Boundary values at $149.99 / $150.00 / $150.01 (AC-3)
steps: The order total is $200.
The order total is $200.
The order total is $200.
Check the result.
add_tests.expected: At $149.99: 20% is $29.998, so the discount is $30.00 after rounding to the cent — check the shop rounds this way (it could also be $29.99). At $150.00: 20% is exactly $30.00 — the cap. At $150.01: 20% is $30.002, so the cap applies and the discount stays $30.00.
